sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13640 of 2023

Applicant :- Brahmmadeen Verma
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy./Addl. Chief Secy. Home Deptt. Lucknow

Counsel for Applicant :- Mahendra Pratap Singh,Farooq Ayoob
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Supplementary affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant and the Counter affidavit filed by the State
are taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.

3. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.376 of 2023, under Section 342, 376(3), 323,
506 IPC, Section 3/4 POCSO Act and Section 3(2)(V) of ST/ST Act, Police Station Jaidpur, District Barabanki.
Brahmmadeen Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy./Addl. ...

1 4.

In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 13 years was slightly mentally challenged had gone out of home on the said date and when she was coming back the applicant called her and took her in a room and committed wrong on her.
The allegation of insertion of finger in the private part was also levelled.
The FIR was lodged on 31.08.2023 after about 2 days of the incident.
In the statement of under Section 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C., the same version was reiterated by the victim.
The medical of the victim done does not corroborate the allegation of any offence punishable under Section 375 IPC read with Section 3 of POCSO Act.
It is also on record that the statement of the victim has been recorded during trial.

In the charge-sheet allegedly there are 19 witnesses out of which one has been examined so far, as such, prima facie,
there is no likelihood of the trial being concluded in near future.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the medical on record not corroborating the allegation against the applicant who is aged about 65 years and is in custody since 01.09.2023 having no criminal history, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Brahmmadeen Verma be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
